main_issue: Who completes Agent D's unfinished analysis section before Thursday's deadline while D is away for a family bereavement

A-B.evidence: B refuses to take on analysis or stay late (T8, T19, T21); A insists 'not a request' (T20), then drops the demand and tells the others to just do their own sections (T24).

A-C.evidence: C says she can't take the analysis (T11, T14); A pushes (T12, T15), then offers to lead and support C (T18), and finally lets everyone just do their own sections (T24).

A-D.evidence: A accepts D's leave (T3) but treats the analysis as needing takeover; D offers to finish it from home (T23) and A says 'That settles it' (T24); A tells D to go be with family (T28).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take the analysis (T8, T11, T14) but never address each other; both end up with only their own sections (T24).

B-D.evidence: B offers condolences (T4) and D thanks B (T5); B never comments on D's offer to finish the section (T23).

C-D.evidence: C never speaks to D; C wanted a plan (T17), and D's offer to finish the section (T23) resolves it, but C does not respond.
